sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Event names: every "Event" column (artist, place and area events, …) gets new 📊 "Event name info" sections. Form: which naming form each name follows — the live bootleg form "YYYY-MM-DD[, early show]: Venue, City, State, Country" or one of the title forms of https://musicbrainz.org/doc/Style/Event: "[artist] at [venue]", "[festival] [N/YYYY]" ("Hellfest 2023, Day 1: Mainstage 01"), "[tour]: [city]", or free form. Style guide near miss: names that almost follow a form, with one entry per reason ("@" or "AT" for "at", " - " for ": ", a colon without one space after it, "'23" or a year glued to the name). Festival edition: year or running number. For names in the live form, the same sections as "Live title info": validity, near miss, date completeness, additional date info, location completeness and the three separator sections. Every entry filters the table. Behind the new settings "Unique-Values Dropdown: Event Name Info" (on by default) and "Unique-Values Dropdown: Event Name Info On These Columns Too" (empty: Event columns only).

Event names are tinted like live release titles: light red with ❌ for an impossible date or a live-form near miss, light yellow with ⚠️ for a plain "-" in the date (same two live-title settings), and light yellow with ⚠️ for a style guide near miss (new setting "Highlight event names that almost follow the style guide as WARNING", ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ FINDINGS, on by default). The ⚠️ WARNING / ❌ ERROR menus get four new rows for them.

Live bootleg titles: new 📊 section "Live title info - Location completeness" on release and release group titles (and on event names): how many ", "-separated parts the location has — 2 (Venue, City), 3 (Venue, City, Country), 4 (Venue, City, State, Country) or 5+. Which part a short location lacks cannot be told, so only the count is shown.
